content.title: How much time do I have to set aside each week?
content.content: A weekly commitment of 3 hours is the minimum. 1h/week for our 1:1 session, 1h/week for reflection exercises, and approximately 10 minutes of practice per day. Additionally (in the whole coaching period) there will be three emotion-focused sessions a 2h.

content.title: What if I realize during the workshop that it's too intense for me?
content.content: We will adjust the coaching to your pace and personal preferences. Since the training is build to reach your goal in 60 days, it would be best to go with it.

content.title: Can I continue working with you after the workshop?
content.content: Absolutely! You’ll have the option to continue the emotional grounding work for another 2 months, building up on what you've already achieved. There will also be group seminars and advanced courses starting in 2026.

content.title: How sustainable is this coaching —will I really become less overwhelmed and more resilient in the long run?
content.content: This coaching is built for lasting impact and can truly be life-changing. You’ll learn various tools to boost your emotional stability and change overwhelming patterns or mental blocks. Keep in mind that consistent practice is key to maintaining long-term results and resilience.
